title: PollingMatch
description: One judge's decision about which polling question, if any, a report's core claim actually answers. reportId is attached by the pipeline rather than echoed by the model, so a model can never mislabel which report it judged. Nullability uses anyOf rather than a type array, and every property is listed in required, so that the same file is accepted verbatim by both providers' structured-output validators.

coreClaim.description: The report's central claim, written as one declarative English sentence. State what the report asserts is or should be the case, not what the report is 'about'. Under 200 characters.

alignedPollId.description: The id of the candidate poll whose question the core claim answers, or null when no candidate asks about the thing this report is actually about. Must be copied verbatim from the candidate list; never invent an id.

evidence.description: Why the alignment holds. All three fields are empty strings when alignedPollId is null.

reportSpan.description: Verbatim span from the headline or summary carrying the core claim, under 200 characters.

pollConcept.description: Verbatim phrase from the chosen poll's questionWording naming the concept the span corresponds to, under 200 characters.

alignment.description: One sentence stating why that span and that concept are the same proposition rather than two related topics. Under 300 characters.

rejection.description: Required when alignedPollId is null: name the closest candidate and say what the report is about that the candidate does not ask about. Empty string when alignedPollId is non-null. Under 300 characters.
